title: ANA Blue Ribbon Sale
typicalWindow: Late Jan – Feb, and again around Aug
notes: ANA's flagship periodic sale on international and domestic fares out of Japan. Exact dates vary year to year — check ANA's website close to the window.

title: AirAsia BIG Sale
typicalWindow: Multiple times a year, often quarterly (e.g. Mar, Jun, Sep, Nov)
notes: Recurring regional flash sale across AirAsia's ASEAN network, usually announced a few days in advance.

title: SIA / Scoot Travel Fair
typicalWindow: Periodic, often tied to travel expos (Mar, Aug)
notes: Fare promotions frequently aligned with the NATAS travel fair in Singapore.

title: MHfriends / MATTA Fair promotions
typicalWindow: Periodic, often around MATTA Fair (Mar, Sep)
notes: Malaysia Airlines regularly runs fare promotions timed with Malaysia's biannual MATTA travel fair.

title: Cathay Pacific seasonal sale
notes: Seasonal fare sales out of Hong Kong, timing varies by year.

title: Korean carrier seasonal sale
notes: Fare promotions out of Seoul, timing varies by year.
